name: com.tesseractsoftwares.praxsuite
description:
Backend-as-a-service for Unity games, powered by Praxsuite. Player accounts, saves, leaderboards, inventories, files and server-authoritative logic - with no server code to write.

Zero dependencies. Install, paste your Workspace ID, ship.

samples.description: Sign a player in and read/write their own save row.
A public top-N leaderboard with a server-authoritative score submit.
Spend currency through a gateway endpoint so the client cannot cheat.
